newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares lose 1.87 pct, off lows on support.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares lose 1.87 pct, off lows on support.

text.p: Turkish shares fell in quiet sales on Monday in a continued consolidation, but rebounded from lows on support awaited at the index's 1,500 level, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 closed down 30 points, or 1.87 percent lower at 1,575, but above a day's low of 1,559.
It has lost 7.35 percent since last Monday's all-time high close of 1,700 after surging 74.2 percent and hitting 17 records from end-1996 to January 27.
Trade volume dived to 26.36 trillion lira from Friday's 36.55 trillion.

Several brokers expected activity to slow down in the first half of this week due to an approaching religious holiday. Turkish markets will be closed next Monday and Tuesday for the Islamic holiday marking the end of Ramadan.
But they anticipate that purchases will strengthen in the last two days of the week when settlements of transactions will be delayed until after the holiday.

Of the 239 shares traded, losers outdid gainers sharply by 164 to 47 and 28 finished stable. The IMKB Industrial dropped 1.71 percent to 1,609, the IMKB Services plunged 4.38 percent to 1,527 and the IMKB Financial eased 0.64 percent to 1,555.

Actives were led by largely state-owned flat steel maker Eregli, up 500 lira at 22,000, T.Isbank's C series, up 2,500 lira at 32,000, Medya Holding, down 1,00 lira at 1,550 and largely state-owned oil refiner Tupras, up 500 lira at 50,500.
They made up 33.2 percent of the total turnover.
